evaluation_improvement_plan_007.evidence: DCPS will consult with the WTU on the development of professional development opportunities that will be made available to teachers rated as Minimally Effective.

evaluation_consequences_008.evidence: DCPS shall retain the right to make the final excessing decision according to the following rubric: Category 1) Previous Year’s Final Evaluation... Highest 50... Lowest 0. The Teacher in the competitive area with the lowest point value overall according to the rubric above shall be the first Teacher to be excessed.
